📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How is the diagonal found?
By Pythagoras on the right triangle formed by the sides: d = √(l² + w²).
Is a square just a special rectangle?
Yes — enter equal length and width and the formulas still hold.
Area vs perimeter?
Area is the surface covered (square units); perimeter is the distance around (units).
